verdict.rationale: Signup needs no credit card, and a community user confirms using a Calendly free tier, so a free individual booking link appears to exist. Community reports also describe limits: features moved off the free tier, and a plan restricted to a single meeting configuration that pushes users to pay. missing for 10: first-party pricing docs stating what the free plan includes (booking link, number of event types, calendar connections), hands-on confirmation that the free link is usable for real founder scheduling.
